David Mark Graham - DG Classic Cars ​ Hi I’m David, a Welshman and the owner of DG Classic Cars based in Northern Italy. ​ DG Classic Cars has grown to become a successful Classic Car business selling across the world with hundreds of happy clients from Northern Europe, the USA and as far south as New Zealand. Italy is blessed with a dry warm climate that preserves old classics so rust is seldom an issue. The quality of stock here is among the very best in the world. I personally inspect every car I sell. I travel the length of Italy finding and purchasing cars to offer as stock or purchased to order through my brokerage service. I enjoy meeting the owners of the cars and hearing their history of ownership and fond memories, the stories behind the metal. I search out only the best cars to bring to market and I would be delighted to sell you one of my cars or to arrange an appraisal and purchase of a car you may have found yourself. When you buy from me I can arrange all the logistics of export, ownership changes, paperwork, registration and shipping so the whole process runs smooth and simple.
